title: Hardened model targeting and Router recovery at the validated checkpoint
points: Saved-model updates now require the exact requested model and cannot fall back to another ticker or silently become a fresh model build.
Model templates are selected from authoritative ticker industry, so Investment Holding requests fail explicitly instead of running a corporate forecast.
Router corrective retries now preserve valid selector graphs and make the smallest structural repair instead of growing or discarding useful plans.

Unknown tickers cannot be silently replaced by a nearby valid symbol, and small multi-company filing lanes preserve already-retrieved pages across a bounded ticker-scaled recovery budget before shaping, then stop re-querying once every requested ticker has source-page coverage.
Fresh model builds cannot be suppressed by an untargeted saved-model action, and non-bank finance-cost ratios are no longer mislabeled as net interest margin.

Closed compute products now require a market-wide rank/screen for their exact metric; single-company, multi-metric, sector-best, low-leverage cash-flow, and bear-market comparisons retain their structured evidence plans.
Focused deployed evals cover HBL workspace preservation, a missing KOHC model, DAWH unsupported handling, National Foods peer correction, and both market-screen recipes.
